name: Smart home maker
title: Smart home device
description: Everyday smart-home brands (speakers, displays, lights, plugs, thermostats, locks, garage openers, robot vacuums, TV sticks), so they can be told apart from the things worth a closer look. Shown only: no alerts, not logged. Google only by its registered address ranges: its Bluetooth company IDs are also used by ordinary phones and fitness bands. Apple and Anker are left out for the same reason, and TP-Link and Xiaomi altogether (most of their address ranges are routers and phones; their devices still show the maker; Xiaomi's smart-home line is Aqara, which is in). Tuya has its own rule.
